fixes.en: A vanguard craft has reported to Battle 7 that it is under surprise attack by an unidentified force.\nAnnihilate the unidentified craft to keep them from getting any closer to the Macross 7 fleet.
fixes.why: Referent: in the old wording 'it' could be read as Battle 7; the source says the vanguard craft is the one under attack.

fixes.en: Basara: "From here on, it's time for a red-hot live show. We're gonna slam our hearts right into you!\n         So let's go big and flashy! Get wild and FIRE!"
fixes.why: 'Go out with a bang' means to finish spectacularly; the source line opens the show (let's go flashy), it does not end anything.

fixes.en: The enemy is trying to overwhelm us with sheer numbers. Teach them that in battle, "quality" beats\n"quantity": sweep away the horde of small fry that has appeared in the wasteland at once.
fixes.why: Source describes a brute-numbers strategy; 'war of attrition' (a long wearing-down fight) is added meaning not in the source.

fixes.en: Ranka: "Sheryl and I are going to show you how to fly in Real Flight Mode!"\nSheryl: "You don't get service like this very often, so be grateful."
fixes.why: Glossary term is 'Real Flight Mode' (also used in objective row 640).
